calculation.expression: -((ret_60 / realized_vol_20) - cross_sectional_median(ret_60 / realized_vol_20)) * (0.5 if breadth_60 < 0.40 else 1.0)
calculation.description: At each completed session, rank cross-asset contrarian exposure to lagging 60-session risk-adjusted momentum. Signal is lagged one session, cross-sectionally centered, and damped rather than inverted when fewer than 40% of assets have positive 60-session returns. Values are winsorized cross-sectionally at the 5th and 95th percentiles. Positive values favor recent relative laggards for the next 10 sessions.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on all 15 tradable cross-asset instruments with regime slices 2024-27, 2028-31, and 2032+. Strong positive IC in the first two slices but negative drift in 2032+; use conservatively and revalidate quarterly.
